entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Chapel (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to an altar and burners.
- 200% bones or ashes experience when offered on the altar.
- 15 seconds of burner time per herb added to burners.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Chapel (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- 250% bones or ashes experience when offered on the altar.
- 18 seconds of burner time per herb added to burners.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Chapel (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- 300% bones or ashes experience when offered on the altar.
- 21 seconds of burner time per herb added to burners.
- Access to swapping between prayerbooks.
- Ability to change chapel decor to other gods.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Command Centre (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Remote access to management of Player owned ports, Managing Miscellania, Archaeology research, and Anachronia base camp.
- 3% ports mission success chance boost.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Command Centre (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- An additional 3% ports mission success chance boost.
- 5 extra workers for Anachronia base camp.
- Archaeology research -3% chronote cost.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Command Centre (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- An additional 4% ports mission success chance boost.
- An additional 5 extra workers for Anachronia base camp.
- Archaeology research 3% speed bonus.
- Access to Miscellania reputation boost and hold.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Town Hall (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Allows collection of Rested Experience that can be transferred to Bonus experience toward any skill.
- Rested experience is gained from logging out anywhere or skilling in the fort.
- Access to Copperpot the banker in the centre of Fort Forinthry.
- Ability to change tree decor to seasons.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Town Hall (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- Rested Experience cap increase.
- Rested experience gain from skilling in the fort increased.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Town Hall (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- Rested Experience cap increase.
- Rested experience gain from skilling in the fort increased.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Workshop (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to the Fort Forinthry Construction training method.
- Access to the Workshop's forge, anvils, Invention workbench, and Archaeology workbench.
- 5% increased Construction experience when constructing from blueprints.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Workshop (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- Remote access to managing Invention machines.
- 10% increased Construction experience when constructing from blueprints.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Workshop (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- Increased Invention machine power by 25%
- 15% increased Construction experience when constructing from blueprints.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Kitchen (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to kitchen facilites in the fort.
- Cutting through spider webs never fails.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Kitchen (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to a cooking supply shop in the fort.
- 3% reduced chance to burn food in the fort kitchen.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Kitchen (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to a soup creation station in the fort.
- 5% extra xp from cooking food in the fort kitchen.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Guardhouse (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- 1% bonus damage dealt on slayer tasks, which is doubled against undead creatures.
- 2% increased elite monster spawn chance.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Guardhouse (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- 5% increased chance to capture a monster using an ushabti.
- An additional 2% increased elite monster spawn chance, for a total of 4%.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Guardhouse (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- Damage-dealing ultimate abilities have a 3% chance to execute non-boss slayer targets. This does not apply to damage-boosting ultimates.
- 10% increased damage against non-boss slayer targets that are below 25% hp.
- An additional 2% increased elite monster spawn chance, for a total of 6%.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Woodcutters' Grove (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to normal trees and oak trees in the Woodcutters' Grove.
- Ability to store log spirits in the wood box.
- Log piles in the Woodcutters' Grove can be used to deposit logs directly to the bank.
- Bird's nests found whilst woodcutting are automatically stored in the backpack.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Woodcutters' Grove (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to willow trees, yew trees and choking ivy in the Woodcutters' Grove.
- Access to a fairy ring in the Woodcutters' Grove.
- Access to a Farming tree patch in the Woodcutters' Grove.
- Bird's nests can be stored in the wood box.
- Bird's nests found whilst woodcutting are automatically stored in the woodbox.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Woodcutters' Grove (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to an elder tree in the Woodcutters' Grove.
- Bird's nests obtained from woodcutting after completing this upgrade have improved rewards.
- Ability to obtain Imcando Hatchet pieces from bird's nests.
- Thurgo can create an Imcando Hatchet with all four Imcando Hatchet pieces and additional materials.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Ranger's Workroom (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to ranger's workroom facilities, including fletching workbench and spinning wheel.
- 2% chance for the workroom to supply materials while fletching various weapons and ammo.
- 1% chance to fletch an extra bundle of arrow shafts in the workroom.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Ranger's Workroom (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- 1% chance to fletch an extra bundle of ranged ammo and headless arrows in the workroom.
- 2% chance to fletch strung bows when fletching unstrung bows in the workroom.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Ranger's Workroom (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText:
- 5% increase to earned fletching XP while inside the ranger's workroom.
- Unlocked 'Wisdom of Anima' perks can be toggled via the fletching workbench to take effect inside the workroom.
- With 'Wisdom of Anima' enabled, dinarrows are imbued with great efficiency but award little XP.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Botanist's Workbench (Tier 1)
entries.requirementText:
- Access to the botanist's bench and Granny Rowan's herblore services.
- Granny Rowan can decant your potions and blubbers for you.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Botanist's Workbench (Tier 2)
entries.requirementText:
- Granny Rowan has a limited stock of tradeable herblore supplies available for purchase.
- You are now able to receive unnoted vials of water from the botanist's workbench.

entries.name: Fort Forinthry: Botanist's Workbench (Tier 3)
entries.requirementText: - Granny Rowan will prepare overloads and overload salves for you, allowing you to make them in larger quantities at the botanist's workbench.

entries.name: Geodes when mining
entries.requirementText:
When mining core rocks, you now have a chance to find geodes, which stack in your backpack. Crack open a geode for a random reward (such as gems and spirit shards)!
Level 50 free-to-play core mining nodes and below yield sedimentary geodes.
Member core mining nodes yield igneous geodes, and rare metamorphic geodes.

entries.name: Device: Soul-in-a-box
entries.requirementText: Creates a soul that distracts pickpocket targets.

entries.name: Device: Urn enhancer
entries.requirementText: Gives additional experience when teleporting urns.

entries.name: Device: Fishing rod-o-matic
entries.requirementText: An all purpose fishing device suitable for most types of fishing. You can also adapt this research to augment crystal fishing rods.

entries.name: Device: Sprinkler MK1
entries.requirementText: A persistent device that is placed in a flower patch and keeps adjacent vegetable patches watered.

entries.name: Device: Book switcher
entries.requirementText: A consumable device that allows you to change your current spellbook or prayers at a bank.

entries.name: Device: Calorie bomb
entries.requirementText: A consumable device that can be charged with fish to deploy for area-of-effect healing.

entries.name: Device: Auto-sanctifier
entries.requirementText: A consumable device that increases the prayer experience of buried bones and scattered ashes on the go.

entries.name: Device: Kinetic cyclone
entries.requirementText: A melee variant of the multicannon capable of rapidly hitting multiple targets at melee range.

entries.name: Device: Dungeoneering lock melter
entries.requirementText: A consumable device that can bypass and unlock any non-key door in Dungeoneering you don't meet the requirements for.

entries.name: Device: B.A.N.K. Stander
entries.requirementText: A consumable device that generates charge whilst you are stood in a bank area. When fully charged it breaks down into invention materials.

entries.name: Device: Monkey mind-control helmet
entries.requirementText: A device that allows for the acquisition of a monkey to serve as a servant in your player-owned house.

entries.name: Device: Electrified box trap
entries.requirementText: A consumable variant of the standard box trap with impeccable catch rates.

entries.name: Device: Oldak coil
entries.requirementText: A magic variant of the multicannon capable of frequently hitting small groups of enemies at medium range.

entries.name: Material: Faceted components

entries.name: Device: Crystal tool siphon

entries.name: Research: Rune ethereal outfit pieces
entries.requirementText: You can now create rune ethereal outfit pieces on an Invention workbench.

entries.name: Device: Pyro-matic
entries.requirementText: An all purpose tinderbox suitable for most types of firemaking. You can also adapt this research to augment crystal tinderboxes.

entries.name: Device: Hammer-tron
entries.requirementText: An all purpose hammer suitable for most types of smithing. You can also adapt this research to augment crystal hammers.

entries.name: Device: Teleportation compactor
entries.requirementText: A device which is capable of enhancing and combining teleportation devices, destroying the original and adding charges into a new item.

entries.name: Research: Shark outfit pieces
entries.requirementText: You can now create shark outfit pieces on an Invention workbench.

entries.name: Research: Alchemical onyx
entries.requirementText: An alchemically enhanced version of the Onyx gem. You should be able to make this into jewellery.

entries.name: Research: Passage of the Abyss
entries.requirementText: Allows you to store multiple compacted teleport items.

entries.requirementText: Unlocks an ability that guarantees your next ability will hit when activated.

entries.requirementText: Unlocks an ability that increases damage against undead when activated.

entries.name: Research: Demon slayer ability codex
entries.requirementText: Unlocks an ability that increases damage against demons when activated.

entries.name: Research: Dragon slayer ability codex
entries.requirementText: Unlocks an ability that increases damage against dragons when activated.

entries.name: Device: Portable fairy ring

entries.name: Device: Spirit tree re-rooter

entries.name: Device: Equipment separator

entries.name: Device: Potion reservoir

entries.name: Device: Divine-o-matic vacuum and empty Divine charge

entries.name: Device: Energy barrel
entries.requirementText: A cosmetic backpack full of divine energy.

entries.name: Device: Herb protector
entries.requirementText: Use a protector on a herb patch to protect it from disease.

entries.name: Device: Liquid patch bomb
entries.requirementText: A device that immediately clears and then notes the produce of any farming patch.

entries.name: Device: Spring cleaner and Tight springs

entries.name: Device: Medium gizmo bag
entries.requirementText: A bag that can store up to 15 gizmos.

entries.name: Device: Large gizmo bag
entries.requirementText: A bag that can store up to 20 gizmos.

entries.name: Device: Mechanised siphon
entries.requirementText: After putting siphons in this device, it will automatically siphon my equipment however I specify.

entries.name: Device: Combat dummy MKII

entries.name: Simple generator

entries.name: Large generator
entries.requirementText: Provides power to other machines. This generator will provide a lot of power.

entries.name: Jumbo generator
entries.requirementText: Provides power to other machines. This generator will provide loads of power.

entries.requirementText: Saws logs into planks. This plank maker has a higher capacity and throughput.

entries.name: Alchemiser
entries.requirementText: Converts any deposited item into gold!

entries.name: Alchemiser mk. II
entries.requirementText: Converts any deposited item into gold! Mk. II requires no fire runes and has a higher capacity and throughput.

entries.name: Auto disassembler
entries.requirementText: Smashes and mashes your objects into components!

entries.name: Auto disassembler mk. II
entries.requirementText: Smashes and mashes your objects into components! Mk. II has higher capacity and throughput.

5% increase to excavation success rate.

Offering this to the Monolith at the Archaeology campus will unlock the 'Persistent Rage' relic power.

Power: Your adrenaline now generates outside of combat.

entries.name: Andvaranaut
entries.requirementText:
Offering this to the Monolith at the Archaeology campus will unlock the 'Sticky Fingers' relic power.

entries.name: Ring of Solomon

entries.name: Ritual site (Ungael)
entries.requirementText:
The Ungael ritual site is a more economical, laid-back Necromancy training method.

Ritual components are more durable, ritual disturbances have increased duration, there's a convenient bank chest, and if you wear Zorgoth's ring, it has a chance to upgrade each time you complete a ritual.

However, Ungael experience rates are slightly lower than Um, and communion rituals cannot be performed here.
